endpoint_device_evidence.connection_policy: No endpoint is enumerated or opened. A later host may explicitly select an input whose identity has been verified as the regular Launch Control 3 Custom Mode 1 port.
endpoint_device_evidence.notes: The repository topology and synthetic messages prove only protocol transforms. They do not prove endpoint identity, receipt, encoder behavior, firmware configuration, reconnect, LED or OLED behavior, or physical usefulness.

gesture_state_machines.transition: value greater than zero selects the addressed lane at the next Core quantum; value zero is an explicit release with no semantic dispatch

gesture_state_machines.input: channel 16 CC20 through CC27 absolute value 0 through 127
gesture_state_machines.transition: route = clamp((value - 64) / 63, -1, 1), with value 64 exactly zero and values 0 and 127 exactly minus one and plus one

semantic_bindings.binding: select lane index CC minus 40 on a positive value; releases do not dispatch
semantic_bindings.rejection: wrong channel, wrong CC, data outside 0 through 127, or duplicate release is ignored and counted without state change

semantic_bindings.binding: set selected-lane route destination CC minus 20 using the signed absolute route transform
semantic_bindings.rejection: no valid selected lane, wrong channel, wrong CC, or invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC28 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to rate index 0 through 15
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC29 maps value divided by 128 to phase in [0,1), retained as the accepted 7-bit phase value
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC30 maps floor(value times 8 divided by 128) to shape index 0 through 7
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC31 maps round(value times 16 divided by 127) to hits 0 through 16
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC32 maps floor(value times 16 divided by 128) to rotation 0 through 15
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC33 maps value divided by 127 to probability with exact zero and one endpoints
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC34 maps value zero to free repeat and positive values to 1 plus floor((value - 1) times 64 divided by 127), clamped 1 through 64
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted

semantic_bindings.binding: CC35 maps value divided by 127 to amplitude with exact zero and one endpoints
semantic_bindings.rejection: invalid data is ignored and counted
